item.title: B.C. government to cut 15,000 jobs over three years, including executive positions
item.description: The B.C. government will cut 15,000 jobs over the next three years as part of its measures to reduce its staggering budget deficits.

item.title: B.C. government's budget deficit to soar to new all-time historic high of $13.3 billion
item.description: The Government of B.C.'s 2026 budget deficit is projected to reach $13.3 billion in 2026, representing a $2 billion year-over-year increase.

item.title: Olympic men's hockey bracket is set and here is Canada's path to gold medal game
item.description: The men's Olympic hockey bracket is set, and we now have a clearer idea of what Canada's path to a gold medal could look like.

item.title: Vancouver Canucks have multiple teams with Evander Kane trade interest: report
item.description: The Evander Kane era seems to be coming to an end for the Vancouver Canucks, as multiple teams are showing reported trade interest.

item.title: Rearm and rebuild: Canada's historic new defence strategy to create 125,000 jobs
item.description: Prime Minister Mark Carney has launched Canada’s first-ever Defence Industrial Strategy, promising to rearm and rebuild the military.

item.title: B.C. government increases speculation and vacancy tax rate for the second consecutive year
item.description: The Government of British Columbia is increasing its Speculation and Vacancy Tax (SVT) rate for the second consecutive year.

item.title: B.C. government hikes school property tax, changes property tax deferment rules
item.description: The Government of British Columbia is raising the School Tax on high-value homes and changing how school property tax rates are calculated.

item.title: B.C. government to slow pace of building new housing and infrastructure projects, including Burnaby Hospital redevelopment
item.description: With growing financial pressures, B.C. government will slow the pace of constructing its housing and infrastructure projects.

item.title: Game-worn Crosby Olympic jersey costs more than average Canadian rent — for a year
item.description: If you're not all that interested in paying rent for a year, perhaps you could own a piece of Olympic history in a Sidney Crosby jersey.

item.title: Evolve E-Bike Share expands into West Vancouver, growing to 130 parking stations across the North Shore this spring
item.description: BCAA's Evolve E-Bike Share program has now expanded into the District of West Vancouver, providing expanded coverage for the North Shore.
